profile-summary: MSc Computer Science graduate from the University of Copenhagen with experience in data-driven software development, machine learning, and large-scale data processing. Skilled in Python and core data science libraries, with projects spanning biometrics, media archives, and computational modeling. I have a strong foundation in statistical analysis, algorithm development, and handling diverse data sources. Comfortable working independently and in cross-functional teams, I am eager to contribute to building data-driven products with real-world impact.

project-desc-1: A simple note-taking Android app with SQLite database for local storage, built with Java and Android Studio. Features include adding, editing, deleting notes, and searching through notes. Dedicated to my mom.
project-desc-2: A breathalyzer prototype using MQ-3 alcohol sensor, Arduino for fun.
project-desc-3: Developed an IoT device to monitor dairy cattle's core body temperature using LoRa wireless technology. Contributed to a research publication on real-time monitoring with implantable biosensors and wearable scanners.
project-desc-4: Implementation of the MSDU-NET architecture for blur image segmentation, based on the paper "MSDU-NET: Multi-Scale Dilated U-Net for Image Segmentation in Blur Images".
project-desc-5: My guided attempt at exploiting the latent space of temporal graph neural networks to efficiently generate fluid dynamics simulations.
project-desc-6: Developed together with a friend in medical field. Based on a given birthdate, time, risk factors, and Serum Bilirubin (mg/dl).
